strategic.users: Curators (granted role) host quiz sessions for casual social play among friends and colleagues; players join anonymously from their own device via link, QR code, or join code, no account required. The job to be done is fast, low-friction group play: a curator gets a room playing within seconds, a player joins and answers without setup friction. Solo mode ("Trial of the Sphinx") extends the same experience to a single player with a guest-to-signed-in conversion tier.
strategic.purpose: A real-time, browser-based quiz platform. Success looks like a curator starting a session and players joining and answering questions live with no account friction, then seeing results/leaderboards immediately.
strategic.personality: Measured, intelligent, grounded — a referee who knows the rules and has no interest in spectacle.
principles: Semantic over literal — reach for tokens that carry meaning, never raw scale values or hardcoded phase colours.
Clarity over decoration — motion and visual flourish exist only to clarify state changes, never as ornament.
Precision over spectacle — the interface confirms and informs quickly; it does not perform enthusiasm the way generic party-quiz apps do.
One shape language — the squircle is the interactive signature across every surface.
Accessible by default — dyslexia-friendly type, reduced motion, and WCAG AA contrast are first-class settings, not afterthoughts.
antiReferences: Avoid generic Kahoot-style visuals — don't look like Kahoot/generic bright primary-color quiz apps: avoid loud saturated flat colors, cartoonish shapes, exclamation-heavy copy.
strategic.accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA baseline. Dyslexia-friendly typeface swap (html[data-font="dyslexic"], OpenDyslexic replaces Albertus Nova / Geist / Geist Mono system-wide via CSS custom properties). Reduced-motion preferences respected; state-communicating motion degrades to instant/crossfade rather than being skipped.

display.purpose: Hero headings, score reveals — ceremonial moments only.

mono.purpose: Join codes, IDs, scores — anywhere a fixed-width glyph grid aids legibility.

dyslexic-override.purpose: Replaces all families system-wide when html[data-font="dyslexic"] is set.

shadows.name: shadow-button
shadows.purpose: Physical press depth on primary buttons.

shadows.name: shadow-button-hover
shadows.purpose: Reduced depth on hover, suggesting lift.

shadows.name: shadow-menu
shadows.purpose: Tight outline shadow for dropdown menus.

motion.name: active-press
motion.purpose: Tactile press feedback on buttons, no animation budget spent.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Default call-to-action button — warm gold fill, squircle shape, physical press shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(84.746% 0.16058 83.298); color: oklch(10.7% 0.031 279.92); border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 20px; font: 600 16px "Geist", sans-serif; box-shadow: 0px 4px 0px 2px oklch(60.602% 0.12686 76.862); transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.76,0,0.24,1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.76,0,0.24,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(90.579% 0.11217 88.004); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); box-shadow: 0px 2px 0px 2px oklch(60.602% 0.12686 76.862); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(84.746% 0.16058 83.298); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Deep indigo fill for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: oklch(64.3% 0.141 281.67); color: oklch(92.3% 0.020 286.05); border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 20px; font: 600 16px "Geist", sans-serif; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.76,0,0.24,1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.76,0,0.24,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(71.3% 0.101 283.54); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(64.3% 0.141 281.67); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input field
components.description: Squircle text input, border darkens on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(14.5% 0.042 278.50) 25%, transparent); color: oklch(92.3% 0.020 286.05); border: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(64.3% 0.141 281.67) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 12px; font: 400 16px "Geist", sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(64.3% 0.141 281.67); background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(10.7% 0.031 279.92) 50%, transparent); outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(55% 0.060 283.00); }

components.name: Default card
components.description: General content panel, subtle indigo tint.
components.css: .ds-card { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(64.3% 0.141 281.67) 5%, transparent); color: oklch(92.3% 0.020 286.05); border: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(64.3% 0.141 281.67) 10%, transparent); border-radius: 24px; padding: 16px; font: 400 16px "Geist", sans-serif; }

components.name: Difficulty badge
components.description: All-caps difficulty tag — easy/medium/hard, solid semantic fill with dark text, squircle corners.
components.css: .ds-badge-hard { background: oklch(56% 0.22 28.32); color: oklch(16% 0.09 26.04); border-radius: 12px; corner-shape: superellipse(2); padding: 2px 8px; font: 700 12px "Geist", sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }

components.name: Streak flame card
components.description: Momentum callout for hot-streak indicators — distinct from danger red.
components.css: .ds-card-flame { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(70% 0.21 40.32) 20%, transparent); color: oklch(92.3% 0.020 286.05); border: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(70% 0.21 40.32) 40%, transparent); border-radius: 24px; padding: 16px; font: 400 16px "Geist", sans-serif; }

components.name: Select
components.description: Native select on the input recipe — squircle, secondary/50 border to secondary on focus.
components.css: .ds-select { width: 100%; border: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(64.3% 0.141 281.67) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 16px; corner-shape: superellipse(2); padding: 10px 40px 10px 10px; background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(31.9% 0.117 277.47) 25%, transparent); color: oklch(92.3% 0.020 286.05); font: 400 16px "Geist", sans-serif; }

components.name: Slider
components.description: Range input — background-lighter track, secondary thumb ringed in background, value shown in mono beside the label.
components.css: .ds-slider { appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(31.9% 0.117 277.47) 40%, transparent); accent-color: oklch(64.3% 0.141 281.67); }

components.name: Progress
components.description: Determinate bar — secondary/25 track, secondary fill scaled on the x axis from the left; never animates width.
components.css: .ds-progress { position: relative; height: 8px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(64.3% 0.141 281.67) 25%, transparent); } .ds-progress-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform-origin: left; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(64.3% 0.141 281.67); transition: transform 300ms; }

components.name: Segmented picker tile
components.description: Option tile in a radiogroup or tab row — squircle card; selected tile inverts to foreground-darker on background.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4px; padding: 12px; border: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(64.3% 0.141 281.67) 25%, transparent); border-radius: 16px; corner-shape: superellipse(2); background: transparent; color: oklch(92.3% 0.020 286.05); } .ds-seg-checked { border-color: oklch(62% 0.03 286); background: oklch(62% 0.03 286); color: oklch(20.2% 0.067 278.57); }

components.name: Stat tile
components.description: Ceremony stat — label over a mono value, tinted by tone (primary, secondary, success, warning, neutral, flame).
components.css: .ds-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 2px solid oklch(84.8% 0.181 88.31); border-radius: 32px; corner-shape: superellipse(2); background: oklch(84.8% 0.181 88.31); color: oklch(20.2% 0.067 278.57); } .ds-stat-label { font: 700 12px "Geist", sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-stat-value { font: 700 28px "Geist Mono", monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Radio group
components.description: Legend over squircle option tiles; checked tile fills secondary, locked tile fades to 45% with a lock glyph.
components.css: .ds-radio { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 20px; border: 2px solid oklch(31.9% 0.117 277.47); border-radius: 16px; corner-shape: superellipse(2); background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(31.9% 0.117 277.47) 10%, transparent); cursor: pointer; } .ds-radio-checked { border-color: oklch(64.3% 0.141 281.67); background: oklch(64.3% 0.141 281.67); color: oklch(20.2% 0.067 278.57); font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: Orakl draws its character from classical antiquity — the oracle, the chronicle, the vault — translated into a sparse, modern interface. The atmosphere is one of quiet authority: dark skies, warm golden light, cool indigo depth. It is a serious tool worn lightly, purposeful without ceremony. The design system is dark-first and dynamically sky-aware: a procedural background shifts through eight celestial phases, and semantic colour tokens respond to each phase rather than holding static values.
keyCharacteristics: Squircle (superellipse) shape language across every interactive surface
Two-family type system: Albertus Nova for ceremony, Geist for work
Tonal depth over shadows; physical press shadows reserved for buttons/menus
Accessibility-first: OpenDyslexic swap, WCAG 2.1 AA baseline

rules.name: Semantic tokens only
rules.body: Use semantic colour tokens (background, foreground, surface) rather than scale values in component styles. Semantic tokens respond to theme and sky-phase overrides automatically.

rules.name: Squircle requires both properties
rules.body: Apply corner-shape-squircle alongside rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl on every interactive element. rounded-* alone produces standard circular corners.

rules.name: Tonal depth over shadows
rules.body: Prefer lighter surface tokens over shadows for hierarchy. Reach for shadow-button only for physical interactivity signals.

rules.name: FABs are squircles
rules.body: Floating action buttons use rounded-2xl + corner-shape-squircle at their fixed size, never rounded-full. One shape language for every action, floating or inline.

rules.name: Font variables, not literals
rules.body: Route every font reference through the --albertus-nova / --geist / --geist-mono CSS variables so the OpenDyslexic accessibility override applies everywhere automatically.

dos: Do use semantic colour tokens (background, foreground, surface) rather than scale values in component styles.
Do use Albertus Nova for display headings and score reveals.
Do apply corner-shape-squircle alongside rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl on every interactive element.
Do prefer tonal depth over shadows for hierarchy.
Do write copy in sentence case and maintain a spartan, professional tone.
Do wire every new navigable route into PAGE_CONFIG before opening a PR.
Do route every font reference through the CSS variables so the OpenDyslexic override applies everywhere.
donts: Don't design toward generic party-quiz visual language (loud saturated flat colours, cartoonish shapes, exclamation-heavy copy — the Kahoot look).
Don't use the featured (violet) colour for functional actions.
Don't hardcode phase-specific values directly in component styles.
Don't animate layout properties for micro-interactions — use transform and opacity.
Don't use sharp (rounded-none) on player-facing or game-play buttons.
Don't omit role, aria-label, or onkeydown on custom interactive elements.
